PEDIGREE_CROSS.decision_rationale: The largest non-jackpot incremental pool merits a frozen 5y stability check; the 3y result does not authorize depth-4 execution.

PEDIGREE_TRANSITION_CROSS.decision_rationale: Some incremental evidence exists, but the smaller pool and temporal/support uncertainty do not yet justify expansion.

TRANSITION_CROSS.decision_rationale: The family is dominated by jackpot-dependent candidates and has too few non-jackpot incremental cases to justify further search.
